title: Excretion and the Kidneys
summary: How the kidneys filter blood, what urine contains, how the body balances water, and what happens when kidneys fail.

ib.note: Nephron structure follows in MYP 5 / CBSE 10

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 11: Transportation in Animals and Plants

objectives: I can explain excretion as removing waste made by the body.
I can describe how the kidneys filter blood and form urine.
I can explain how the kidneys help control the body's water balance.
misconceptions: Excretion and egestion are the same.
Drinking less water is good because you urinate less.
